articles.summary: PR Newswire: Shoot 360 Brings Tech-Powered Basketball Training to San Mateo County, Opening January 30. Shoot 360, the leader in technology-powered basketball training, will open its newest location in San Mateo County on January 30. Located in Belmont at 23 Karen Rd., the new training facility will mark the brand's expansion into the Bay Area.
